sloka: किम् नाम तौ मानुषराजपुत्रा ।वस्माकमेकेन हि राक्षसेन ।सुप्राकृतेनापि निहन्तुमेतौ ।शक्यौ कुतो भीषयसे स्म भीरो ॥६-१५-४॥।।
transliteration: kim nāma tau mānuṣarājaputrā ।vasmākamekena hi rākṣasena ।suprākṛtenāpi nihantumetau ।śakyau kuto bhīṣayase sma bhīro ॥6-15-4॥।।

translations.english: "Those two sons of the king of men could be killed in war by an ordinary Rakshasa among us single handed. O timid one Why are you scaring us?"
